name: Chicken Fajitas
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring stir-fried chicken, peppers, and onions, served with tortillas and various toppings.
recipeIngredient: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.text: Stir-fry the vegetables and chicken over high heat until the chicken is cooked through with spices.
Add Catalina dressing and heat through.
Stir in parsley.
Serve wrapped in flour tortillas with shredded cheese, salsa, sour cream, and guacamole as garnishes.

_similar.name: Tortilla Soup
_similar.description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired soup with chicken, vegetables, and crispy tortilla chips.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute chicken pieces with onion, garlic, and spices until chicken is cooked through.
Add 4 cups water and boil to make stock.
Remove chicken and chop, discarding any bones and skin.
Combine remaining ingredients (except tortilla chips, sour cream, and cheese) and heat through.
To serve, place tortilla chips in soup bowls.
Pour soup over chips and top with sour cream, jalapenos (optional), and shredded cheddar cheese.

_similar.keywords: tortilla soup, Mexican soup, chicken soup, spicy soup

_similar.name: Ken Noodle Supper
_similar.description: A hearty chicken and noodle supper with a creamy sauce, mixed vegetables, and a blend of herbs.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (10 oz/300 g) frozen mixed vegetables

recipeInstructions.text: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes. Cook in butter in a large skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add onion, mushrooms, and garlic. Cook until onion is tender.
Stir in flour, salt, pepper, and herbs. Cook until thickens.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add mustard and noodles. Return to a boil.
Add frozen vegetables. Stir and cook for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: chicken noodle supper, creamy sauce, comfort food

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Mexican Fudge
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy baked appetizer served on Triscuits.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup taco or salsa sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Grease a 9×11 in pan and spread the cheddar cheese evenly on the bottom.
Lightly beat the eggs and mix with taco or salsa sauce.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheddar cheese.
Top with the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Cut into squares while warm and serve on Triscuits.

_similar.keywords: Mexican fudge, baked cheese dip, salsa appetizer, cheesy squares

_similar.name: Pepper Chicken Fettucini
_similar.description: A colorful and flavorful chicken fettucini dish with sweet peppers, mushrooms, and Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: 2 sweet red peppers, cut in strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a pan. Add chicken, peppers, onion, mushrooms, and seasoning. Stir-fry over medium heat until chicken is cooked through.
Add hot cooked fettucini noodles and toss.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and toss. Serve hot.
